kevin: Heads-up: a customer hit duplicated token charges when a streaming session fell back mid-request and a toolcall was retried on the new route. short trace below.

maria: paste?

kevin: ```
2026-06-11T10:01:02Z stream start session=s-441 prefix=102
2026-06-11T10:01:03Z sidecar-A invoked toolcall t-99 -> client hung -> sidecar-A emitted provisional(maybe reserved) tokens=40 route=eu-west
2026-06-11T10:01:04Z router fallback -> us-central, client reconnect resume=rt-441
2026-06-11T10:01:05Z sidecar-B retried toolcall t-99' -> emitted confirmed tokens=40 route=us-central
Ledger shows both rows -> billed 80 tokens
```

sasha: Looks like provisional rows are per-route and finalizer couldn't find the provisional to update.

anita: Two prongs: 1) generate a server LRID at initial handling and return it in the stream handshake so retries carry same logical id; 2) ledger must dedupe/update by LRID (final overwrites provisional) rather than insert a separate row.

olivia: Console UX: default view should hide provisional/reserved rows. Add a toggle "show pending/reserved" plus a status column and a small banner "Pending entries may change after reconciliation."

sasha: Telemetry: add fields lrid, provisional_bool, resume_token_hash, provisional_ts, origin_route, final_route, final_token_count. Version meter proto.

kevin: For quotas: provisional should reserve capacity (affects quota and concurrency) but not be invoice-billed until confirmed. Billing/legal to confirm.

anita: I'll scope a backfill job to merge provisionals up to 14 days back and alert on leftovers older than 7d. Also add reconciliation metrics.

sam: QA: add synthetic canary scenarios (fallback+delay+gc) and a billing integration test to ensure invoices only include confirmed tokens.

billing-bot: billing review requested: "reserve vs bill" policy.

kevin: Action list: MARIA -> proto changes, SASHA -> router/sidecar LRID propagation, OPS -> ledger update-by-lrid, OLIVIA -> console filter+status, ANITA -> backfill + metrics, SAM -> test harness. I'll open tickets and include canary plan.

maria: will add provisional_row_hint and provisional_ts in final events for debug.

sasha: tiny detail: LRID must be server authoritative and unique per logical request; clients may echo it but cannot create it. Also include original provisional timestamp in final event for race analysis.

kevin: thanks all, tagging billing/legal and support docs for KB. :thumbsup:
